description: This is a test module written in Python, using pytest and asyncio to test the integration of OpikLogger within the litellm framework. It contains multiple test functions that verify batching behavior, trace/span creation, and attaching to existing traces.

methods.name: test_opik_logging_http_request()
methods.description: Tests that batched HTTP requests to Opik are made correctly during async chat completions, verifying batching logic and request sending.

methods.name: test_sync_opik_logging_http_request()
methods.description: Tests that synchronous HTTP requests to Opik are batched correctly during multiple completions, verifying request counts and batching.

methods.name: test_opik_logging()
methods.description: Performs end-to-end testing of the OpikLogger's logging during async completions, including streaming and non-streaming responses.

methods.name: test_opik_attach_to_existing_trace()
methods.description: Verifies that attaching to an existing trace via provided trace_id results in no new trace creation and correct span parent linkage.

methods.name: test_opik_create_new_trace()
methods.description: Ensures that when no trace_id is provided, a new trace and span are created and linked appropriately, with correct tagging.
